chat.t: Hello!
I'm Reanna, a reporter in need of the Fixer's help!
Excuse me...?
Well, the thing is...
We're preparing a special broadcast on our channel.
And we'd like to interview you, Fixer!

o: So that's what this is about.

chat.t: Would it be possible to meet up for an interview?
I know the perfect place for just the two of us to talk!
Sure! I'll send you the exact meeting place and time separately!
See you then!
Did you make it back safely?
It looks like you just finished showering and are lying in bed!

o: Did you install cameras in my house or something?

chat.t: It's nothing like that...!

o: Your reporter instincts are way too intense.

chat.t: ...That's so sad.
I'll contact you again soon!
Thank you so much for agreeing to the interview today!
You've helped contribute to a cleaner society!

o: It's not like my private life is some ground-breaking info.
Wait, everything we talked about today isn't going to be made public, right?
Hurry up and tell me no.
You're making me extremely anxious here.

chat.t: Don't worry!
I'll contact you again soon!

lines.t: So, I went out to have a chat with the wide-eyed beauty.
I went to the coordinates she sent... but why is the meeting place here?
Outskirts
Ah! Over here! Over here!
It looks like you had a hard time getting here! You're sweating.
It wasn't just a little hard, it was exhausting.
I thought we were meeting at a cozy cafe. I had no idea we'd be meeting in the middle of nowhere.
But there's really no one around here, right?
Mmm, according to my data, this area only gets four visitors a day!
So! With a 96% probability, we will be able to conduct our interview quietly and without any interruptions!
Forget the interview for a second. Let's do it later.
I'm so out of breath I can barely speak.
Ah, your stamina is significantly lower than my estimates, Fixer!
In that case... I must lower the estimate from 70 to 20...
Alright, noted!
Noted what?
You've been mumbling weird things to yourself this whole time.
Ah! It's nothing!
Shall we walk along this path and chat?
Forest
As we walked, we ended up on a forest path on the outskirts of Humanitas.
Are my photos or videos going to be on your broadcast too?
Yes! I'm sure the viewers are curious to see what you look like, Fixer!
After all, the role of media is to deliver nothing but the truth!
Without a single lie! We must show our viewers exactly who you are as a Fixer!
Well, in that case, I guess one photo should be fine.

Yes!
Now look at the camera and smile!
But are you taking it with me? Like a selfie together?
And are you using a Quartz to take a press photo? Don't you have a camera?
Ah, the Quartz performance is so good these days, the photos turn out great!
Great! Smile a bit wider!
Just how many photos are you taking...
And so, I took press photos that looked suspiciously like selfies with Reanna.
And then...
First, I did some research on you, Fixer!
Research?
(Did she really have that much information on me?)
Yes! First of all, you're the very first escapee from the Panoticon, and you've been at the center of various other incidents...
Oh, and you recently went shopping and spent around 20,000 Credits...
Wait, how do you know that?
Lately, it seems you have no concept of day or night, staying awake at night and sleeping during the day...?
I collected your sleep duration data and put together some statistics!
Wait, what are you going to use those statistics for anyway?
Collecting objective information and organizing it neatly is an important virtue of a reporter!
Collecting this kind of information... isn't that an invasion of privacy?
We guarantee the public's right to know!
And where did my rights go?
Don't worry! We want you to succeed more, more, and even more, Fixer!
I'm so curious to see how far your reputation will reach, Fixer...
Ahem!

A-Anyway!
Let's continue with the interview!
So you're just going to ignore what I said...
I've mapped out your daily routine into an algorithm, Fixer!
I was worried when you went to bed about two hours late last Thursday! Going to sleep so late isn't good for your health...!
It felt like she wouldn't let me go if I didn't cooperate with the interview.
I gave her some half-hearted answers and rushed back home.

chat.t: Hello, {player}! Do you happen to have some time?
Having monitored your Fixer schedule for the past ten days, I predict a 100% chance that you have free time today!
I'd like to ask you some follow-up questions based on the interview we did last time!
I think it would be best to meet up in person again!

o: We're meeting where we met last time, right?

chat.t: Ah!
No need for that!
This time, I'll come find you at your Hideout, {player}!

o: Do you even know where my Hideout is?

chat.t: Yep!
Isn't it this address?
Reanna sent an address.

o: How did you find out? This is creepy.

chat.t: Today was fun!
Can we meet again next time?

o: I'm sure we'll meet again sometime.
Did you change my Quartz home screen to this?

chat.t: Ah! Yes!
It looked a little inconvenient for you to use,
so I tidied up your home screen!
U-Um... was it uncalled for...?

o: It looks nice now that it's clean.

chat.t: Thank you!
If you ever need help again, feel free to contact me anytime!
I, Reanna, will help you with everything!

o: But why are there so many folders inside folders now?

lines.t: I thought she would show up much later...
I guess I seriously underestimated Reanna.
Hideout
Who is it...?
{player}, it's me, Reanna!
What, you're here already?
Sorry for being so late!
...You're incredibly early.
It hasn't even been ten minutes since you sent that message.
What, were you waiting in front of my Hideout?
A true reporter must go anywhere, anytime for a story!
That's not a reporter, that's a stalker.
(But wait...)
(Having a beautiful girl follow me around like this... might actually be a win?)
Ahem.
Well, I mean... stalkers aren't always bad. If I'm fine with it, then who cares?
But still... this is a bit too fast, don't you think?
Hmm... according to my data, I was sure you'd like this...
I've been wondering, what exactly is this 'data' you keep talking about?
Ah! It's my coverage material on {player}, of course!
Can you show me?
It's only fair that I check if it's actually about me.

W-What? That...
Ah!

...
What? You know all this about me?
How on earth do you even know the temperature of my Hideout's refrigerator?
Mmm, it wasn't particularly difficult...!
{player}, let's just say... it's information obtained by scanning the electronic devices around you...?
That's just...
stealing my data without permission, isn't it?
I-It's not like that...! I'm so sorry...
U-Um, are you really upset?
...Well. How do you think I feel right now?
Judging by the movement of your pupils and the depth of the wrinkles on your forehead right now, {player}...!

It is not...
anger...
Actually...!
You're actually pleased!
It's embarrassing when you say it out loud like that.
That receiver of yours really is high-performance.
T-The option of you being pleased was completely out of my expectations...!
So you really do have these tastes!
Data collection complete... If I compile the statistics based on the data so far...!
Are you really going to say you know me based on just that?
Don't you want to know more about me?
Of course I do...!
Not just data made of numbers...
And not just data made of text...
I want to know more about that invisible aura of yours, {player}, that can't be visualized!
(I have no idea what she's talking about.)
(Hmm, but still.)
Alright, I'll tell you.
But on one condition: I'm telling you my way, not yours.
Wow...! Sounds great!
{player}, I want to know absolutely everything about you!
And so, I spent the entire night talking with Reanna.

chat.t: Are you doing well?
Lately, you've been eating properly according to your calorie needs,
and you seem to be sleeping well!

o: There's no point in even arguing.

chat.t: Thank you for all your help!
Thanks to you, I'm predicting a slight bump in views for this video!
Oh, by the way,
it's just a small token of my appreciation,
There's something I want to give you as a gift, {player}!
Could we meet up at the Humanitas shopping mall?

o: Well, I won't say no to a gift.

chat.t: Yay!
I'll let you know the time separately!
See you then!
Whew...
I was so startled when you ran off with my tablet computer!
But since you gave it back... it's fine!

o: I was really curious about what kind of juicy secrets you were hiding in that computer.

chat.t: That's a secret!
{player}, I'll make sure to keep your precious information all to myself too...!

o: That sounds pretty creepy when you put it like that.
But about those photos we took earlier...
Are those really for an article?

chat.t: Yes! The photos will be featured in the video!

o: Then why is our selfie set as the wallpaper on your tablet?

chat.t: So you saw that too...

lines.t: I went to the Humanitas shopping mall to meet Reanna.
It was usually bustling with crowds, but for some reason, it was quiet today.
Humanitas Shopping Mall
There aren't many people here today.
I knew it!
{player}, I researched beforehand to find the least busy hours at the mall, all so I could spend some quiet time with you!
Yeah. I figured you'd do something like that.
Let's go this way!
The shop with the gift I want to buy for you, {player}, is right this way!
Hmm... I wonder which shirt suits you better, this one or that one...
According to my data, red suits you better!
But my personal preference is blue over red...!
Sigh... but I shouldn't just pick out clothes for {player}, without asking, right...?
They all look the same to me.
What does the color matter? Clothes are just clothes.
No, wait! I must buy the outfit that will make {player} look absolutely the best!

When in doubt!
Hehe, you've just got to try both on!
Now, why don't you head over to the fitting room and try them on?
W-Wait a minute!
Sigh, this is such a pain...
And so, I was practically shoved into the fitting room.
...I'll just throw something on and go out.
But I wonder if this fits.
...It doesn't just sort of fit, it fits absolutely perfectly.
Ah! Did you come out?
Wow! I think blue suits you much better than red!
...Standing like this feels awkward.
I'd like to purchase this shirt, please.
Yes!
After that, I followed Reanna around shopping for clothes...
and tried on dozens of different outfits.
I knew it! Bright colors definitely suit you better than dark ones, {player}!
We'll take this one!
I walked through the entire mall from the first floor to the top floor with Reanna.
Now, I'm so exhausted I feel like I'm going to die.
{player}, what about this one?
{player}, would you like to try that one on too?
Ugh...
{player}, hey!
I'm really... exhausted now...
Wow, we're all done!
From head to toe, complete!
Is this... right?
How on earth did you find out my body measurements?
Ah... that!
What, did you sneak in while I was sleeping and measure me?
Mmm...
What's this? Why did you suddenly go quiet?
...No way.
Did you actually sneak in while I was asleep?
But seriously, how did you even get into my Hideout?
T-That was also...
Wait, give me that.
A-Ah?
Anything but this!
Let me take a look at that tablet computer of yours.
Ah! Th-That is a secret!
No way. I'm not giving it back.
Catch me if you can.
Ah! Please stop right there...!
And with that, I took off running with Reanna's tablet computer.
But the device was locked with a password, so I couldn't check it in detail.
